id.title: Membuat masa depan generasi muda lebih aman 💪✨
id.description:
Pertanyaan tulus dari kaum muda di sebuah festival universitas.

“Pensiun Nasional, apakah akan baik untuk generasi kita?”

Bagi generasi muda, lapangan kerja tertunda, dan persiapan untuk masa depan menjadi lebih sulit.

Kementerian Kesehatan dan Kesejahteraan memperluas dukungan untuk Pensiun Nasional agar kaum muda dapat mempersiapkan masa depan dengan lebih aman.

Kami memperluas kredit persalinan dan dinas militer untuk memastikan bahwa periode kontribusi diakui sepenuhnya, dan kami juga mempromosikan dukungan untuk premi pertama yang dibayarkan oleh kaum muda.

Untuk memastikan bahwa masa kini kaum muda tidak menimbulkan kecemasan di masa depan, kami akan lebih saksama mendengarkan dan berdiri bersama Anda. 💙

snippet.title: 놀이가 자라는 시간🧸, 웃음이 커지는 순간 🎈
snippet.description:
어른에게는 작은 놀이일 수 있지만,
아이들에게는 하나의 세상이 됩니다🌈

직접 그리고, 만들고, 뛰어놀며
아이들은 오늘도 자기만의 방법으로

id.title: Saatnya bermain untuk berkembang🧸, saat tawa menjadi lebih riuh🎈
id.description:
Bagi orang dewasa, ini mungkin hanya permainan kecil,

tetapi bagi anak-anak, ini menjadi sebuah dunia utuh 🌈

Dengan menggambar, membuat, dan berlarian,

anak-anak terus mengembangkan imajinasi dan tawa mereka dengan cara unik mereka sendiri hingga saat ini.

Mulai dari menjelajahi dadu kertas 🎲

piknik dunia kuning, membuat kipas 🌿

dan bahkan bermain lempar tangkap dengan mainan, meminta bantuan angin 🪁

Kisah-kisah berharga tentang permainan anak-anak, yang ditemukan dalam perayaan Hari Anak 💛

en-US.title: A time for play to grow🧸, a moment when laughter grows louder🎈
en-US.description:
It may be a small game for adults,

but for children, it becomes a whole world🌈

By drawing, making, and running around,

children continue to cultivate their imagination and laughter in their own unique ways today.

From exploring paper dice🎲

a yellow world picnic, making fans🌿

and even playing catch with toys, asking the wind to help🪁

Precious stories of children's play, encountered in celebration of Children's Day💛

The Ministry of Health and Welfare will work together to create days where all children can play to their heart's content and grow up safely.

id.title: Pat Pat EP15 | Satu kata dari seseorang akan tetap terpatri di hatimu lebih lama dari yang kau kira.
id.description:
Sepatah kata dari seseorang dapat terpatri di hati kita lebih lama dari yang kita duga.

Kata-kata penghiburan yang mengatakan bahwa semuanya akan baik-baik saja, tatapan yang diam-diam percaya pada kita, dan bahkan ajaran yang menunjukkan jalan yang benar.

Saya dengan tulus berterima kasih kepada semua guru yang telah memberikan bimbingan hangat mereka untuk membantu saya menjadi seperti sekarang ini.

id.description:

en-US.title: Reducing Welfare Blind Spots, Strengthening the ‘Welfare Safety Mat’
en-US.description:
The government has discussed and approved measures to strengthen the welfare safety net to reduce blind spots in welfare services.

This plan focuses on supplementing the limitations of the existing system, where households in crisis must apply directly to receive support, and transitioning to a proactive welfare system where the government proactively identifies and supports those in need.

The Ministry of Health and Welfare will continue to improve the system to narrow gaps in the welfare safety net and ensure that necessary support reaches citizens in need more quickly.

snippet.title: 영주 의료혁신 간담회 | 같은 마음이 모인 자리💌
snippet.description:
아픈 순간,
어디로 가야 할지 막막했던 경험.

그 이야기가 모여
지역 의료의 현실을 보여주었습니다.

아이의 열이 떨어지지 않던 밤,
응급 상황 앞에서 망설여야 했던 시간들⏳

영주에서 만난 주민과 의료진,
그리고 현장을 지키는 사람들의 목소리는
단순한 이야기가 아닌 지금 우리가 마주한 현실이었습니다.

그 작은 이야기들이 모여
문제가 되고, 해결의 방향이 될 수 있도록,

그리고 그 목소리는
정책으로 이어져 조금 더 가까운 의료를 만들어갑니다.

보건복지부는 지역의료 강화를 향해
현장의 목소리를 정책으로 이어가겠습니다🤝

en-US.title: Full tuition support, but 10 years in the local area?
en-US.description:
The ‘Regional Doctor System’ is being implemented to address the shortage of medical personnel in local areas.

Local students will be selected, educated at local medical schools, and undergo training at local hospitals.

While the government provides tuition and living expenses, there is a condition requiring them to work in the region for approximately 10 years.

To ensure this does not remain merely a formality, plans are in place to improve the education and training systems as well as the working environment.

Creating a structure that encourages doctors to remain in the region is the core of this system.

id.title: Dukungan untuk premi Pensiun Nasional bulan pertama bagi mereka yang lahir pada tahun 2009 dan se...
id.description:
Mulai tahun 2027, pemerintah akan mensubsidi premi Pensiun Nasional bulan pertama untuk kaum muda yang berusia 18 tahun.

Ini berlaku untuk semua pemuda berusia 18 tahun, tanpa memandang pendapatan atau status pekerjaan.

Hal ini karena pendaftaran lebih awal memungkinkan periode pembayaran yang lebih panjang di masa mendatang, yang membantu perencanaan pensiun.

Ini memastikan bahwa periode pendaftaran tidak terlewatkan sekaligus mengurangi beban premi awal.

Ini adalah kebijakan yang dirancang untuk menciptakan titik awal yang lebih adil.

en-US.title: Support for the first month's National Pension premium for those born in 2009 and later? Why?
en-US.description:
Starting in 2027, the government will subsidize the first month's National Pension premium for young adults turning 18.

This applies to all 18-year-old youths, regardless of income or employment status.

This is because enrolling early allows for a longer future payment period, which helps with retirement planning.

It ensures that the enrollment period is not missed while reducing the burden of the initial premium.

It is a policy designed to create a more equitable starting line.

id.title: [Cock! Clip] Bagian 3: Hanya Memberikannya | Hanya Memberikannya Kepada Mereka yang Benar-Benar M...
id.description:
Di saat-saat Anda menghadapi kesulitan mendesak terkait makanan Anda selanjutnya karena keadaan yang tak terduga,

kami menyediakan makanan dan kebutuhan sehari-hari terlebih dahulu, tanpa prosedur yang rumit.

Ini adalah sistem yang dirancang untuk mereka yang sangat membutuhkan bantuan saat ini, yang disebut Geunyang Dream.

Anda dapat menerima 3 hingga 5 barang per orang di pusat layanan terdekat, dan kami akan menghubungkan Anda dengan layanan kesejahteraan jika diperlukan.

Dukungan bukan untuk semua orang, tetapi untuk mereka yang benar-benar membutuhkannya saat ini.

Di saat-saat di mana "makanan lebih penting daripada penjelasan," Geunyang Dream hadir untuk mendukung Anda.

Lihat videonya sekarang.

en-US.description:
In moments when you face immediate difficulties regarding your next meal due to unexpected circumstances,

we provide food and daily necessities first, without any complicated procedures.

In moments where "food comes before explanation," Geunyang Dream is there to support you.

Check it out in the video now.

en-US.title: [Cock! Clip] Part 3: Just Giving It Away | Just Giving It Away to Those Who Really Need It
en-US.description:
Have you ever had a moment where life suddenly felt hopeless, causing you to worry first, "What am I going to eat tomorrow?"

In such times, there is a system that allows you to receive support for food and daily necessities without complicated application procedures or proof of income.

It is called "Geunyang Dream."

If you visit a nearby Geunyang Dream corner, those in desperate need of help can receive 3 to 5 basic food items and daily necessities per person. If difficulties persist, you can also be connected to necessary welfare services through counseling.

In those moments when "food comes before explanation," this is a support system you should definitely know about.

Check it out in the video now!

en-US.title: Life comes before distance; we will reach you faster. 🚁
en-US.description:
In mountainous Gangwon-do, the ‘distance’ felt in emergency situations is felt even more acutely.

While the treatment environment at the hospital level is gradually improving,

the time spent before reaching the hospital remains a fierce battle that determines life or death.

Given the reality that 15 out of the 18 cities and counties in Gangwon-do are classified as areas vulnerable to emergency medical care,

we are listening directly to voices from the field and re-examining the entire transport system.

We will continue to implement the necessary changes to ensure that patients receive timely treatment, faster and more accurately.

snippet.description:
도움이 꼭 필요한 순간인데도
동의가 어렵다는 이유로
손길이 닿지 못하던 시간이 있었습니다

누군가에겐
그 기다림이 너무 길었을지도 모릅니다

이제는 미성년자 등
스스로 신청이 어려운 경우,
담당 공무원이 수급권자를 대신하여
생계급여를 신청할 수 있고,
간이 소득·재산 조사가 허용 됩니다

막혀 있던 절차는 덜어내고
도움은 조금 더 빠르게,
보호는 조금 더 가까이

늦지 않게 닿아야 할 마음에
국가가 먼저 움직이겠습니다

도움이 꼭 필요한 순간인데도
동의가 어렵다는 이유로
손길이 닿지 못하던 시간이 있었습니다

누군가에겐
그 기다림이 너무 길었을지도 모릅니다

이제는 미성년자 등
스스로 신청이 어려운 경우,
담당 공무원이 수급권자를 대신하여
생계급여를 신청할 수 있고,
간이 소득·재산 조사가 허용 됩니다

막혀 있던 절차는 덜어내고
도움은 조금 더 빠르게,
보호는 조금 더 가까이

늦지 않게 닿아야 할 마음에
국가가 먼저 움직이겠습니다

en-US.title: What if the child needs urgent help but guardian consent is difficult to obtain?
en-US.description:
There were times when help could not reach those who desperately needed it, simply because obtaining consent was difficult.

For some, that wait may have felt too long.

Now, for minors or others who find it difficult to apply on their own, a designated public official can apply for livelihood benefits on behalf of the beneficiary, and simplified income and asset investigations are permitted.

We will streamline the blocking procedures, bring help a little faster, and bring protection a little closer.

The state will take the initiative to reach those who need it before it is too late.

#WelfareBlindSpots #ChildProtection #DisabilitySupport

snippet.description:
아침에 눈을 뜨고,
오늘 할 일을 떠올리며 하루를 시작합니다.

하루를 채우는 일들은 크게 다르지 않지만,
그 과정을 만들어가는 방식은
저마다의 모습으로 이어집니다.

익숙한 일상 속에서
각자의 자리에서 최선을 다해
하루를 이어가는 시간들.

누군가에겐 당연한 이 하루가
더 많은 사람에게도 자연스럽게 이어지기를.

각자의 방식으로 살아가는 하루가
존중받는 세상을 바라봅니다. 🌿

#일상의소중함 #함께사는세상 #따뜻한이야기

en-US.description:
I open my eyes in the morning and start the day by thinking about what I need to do.

The tasks that fill the day are not much different, but the way we shape that process unfolds in our own unique ways.

Time spent doing our best in our respective places within familiar daily routines to carry on the day.

May this day, which is taken for granted by some, naturally continue for many more people as well.

I look forward to a world where days lived in individual ways are respected. 🌿

#MinistryOfHealthAndWelfare #NationalDisabilityDay #InclusiveSociety

#PreciousnessOfDailyLife #WorldTogether #HeartwarmingStory

snippet.description:
소소하지만 확실한 혁신행정, '소.확.신!' 이번 영상에서는 국민투표에서 뜨거운 호응을 얻었던 '미숙아 및 선천성이상아 의료비 지원' 정책을 소개합니다.

아픈 아기를 돌보느라 마음 졸이는 부모님들, 거기에 헉 소리 나는 병원비 영수증까지 더해져 정말 막막하셨죠? 😢
이제 무거운 병원비 짐은 정부가 확실하게 덜어드리겠습니다!

💡 무엇이 소확신(확실하게) 달라졌나요?
✅ 가구 소득기준 쿨~하게 전면 폐지! 맞벌이라서, 소득이 기준을 넘어서 지원받지 못하던 억울함은 이제 끝! 누구나 지원받으실 수 있습니다.

✅ 헉 소리 나는 병원비, 든든하게 지원!

미숙아: 출생 체중에 따라 최대 2,000만 원까지!

선천성 이상아: 최대 700만 원까지!

선천성 질환을 가진 미숙아: 두 한도를 합쳐 최대 2,700만 원까지 팍팍 지원해 드립니다.

📱 신청도 아주 간편해요!
복잡한 서류 뭉치 들고 보건소까지 직접 가실 필요 없습니다 ❌
필수 서류 몇 가지만 챙겨서 'e-보건소 포털'이나 '아이마중' 앱을 켜고 집에서 폰으로 쓱~ 편하게 신청하세요!

우리 소중한 아이들이 치료에만 전념하고 건강하게 쑥쑥 자랄 수 있도록, 보건복지부가 부모님들의 가장 든든한 육아 동지가 되겠습니다. 💪

자세한 혜택과 신청 방법, 담당자가 직접 알려드립니다! 영상으로 바로 확인해 보세요 🎬

en-US.title: Shocked by the hospital bills? Up to 27 million won in support for hospital expenses for prematur...
en-US.description:
Small but Certain Innovation in Administration, 'So.Hwak.Shin!' In this video, we introduce the 'Medical Expense Support for Premature and Congenital Abnormalities Infants' policy, which received an enthusiastic response in the public vote.

Parents who worry while caring for a sick baby, and then feel completely at a loss with shocking hospital bills added to the mix, right? 😢

Now, the government will definitely lighten the heavy burden of hospital expenses!

💡 What has changed with SoHwakShin (certainty)?

✅ Household income criteria coolly and completely abolished! The unfairness of not receiving support because you are a dual-income couple or your income exceeded the threshold is over! Anyone can receive support.

✅ Reliable support for shocking hospital bills!

Premature Infants: Up to 20 million won depending on birth weight!

Congenital Abnormalities Infants: Up to 7 million won!

Premature Infants with Congenital Diseases: We provide generous support of up to 27 million won by combining both limits.

📱 Applying is super easy!

There is no need to go to the public health center in person carrying a stack of complicated documents ❌

Just gather a few essential documents, open the 'e-Public Health Center Portal' or the 'I-Majung' app, and apply conveniently from home using your phone!

The Ministry of Health and Welfare will be your most reliable parenting partner so that our precious children can focus solely on treatment and grow up healthy. 💪

A representative will personally explain the detailed benefits and application methods! Check it out right away in the video 🎬

snippet.title: 열여덟, 그냥 지나가는 숫자가 아닙니다
snippet.description:
그동안 국민연금은 정보가 많은 소수만 추후납부 제도를 활용해 혜택을 본다는 지적이 있었습니다. 이제 2027년부터 지원되는 생애 첫 보험료가 이 장벽을 허뭅니다. 국가가 첫 단추를 끼워줌으로써, 청년들은 나중에 취업한 뒤에 원한다면 공백기만큼의 보험료를 낼 수 있는 기회가 생겼고  가입 기간을 획기적으로 늘릴 수 있게 됩니다. 정보 차이로 연금 수령액이 달라지는 불공정을 원천 차단하겠습니다.
(4.23 보건복지부 장관 엑스 메시지 인용) 

💚💚

처음으로
내 이름으로 시작되는 시간,
내 선택이 쌓이기 시작하는 순간

이제 그 출발선에
국민연금이 함께합니다

✔ 첫 한 달 보험료는 정부가 지원

같은 출발선 위에서,
더 공정하게 시작할 수 있도록

#국민연금 #청년정책
#미래준비 #사회안전망 #보건복지부

en-US.title: Eighteen is not just a passing number.
en-US.description:
It has been pointed out that the National Pension has benefited only from the deferred payment system, which is utilized by a select few with ample information. Now, the "First Lifetime Premium" support, starting in 2027, will break down this barrier. By having the government take the first step, young people will have the opportunity to pay premiums for their gaps in employment if they wish, and they will be able to significantly extend their contribution period. We will fundamentally eliminate the unfairness where pension payouts vary due to differences in information.

(Quoting the Minister of Health and Welfare's X-Message on April 23)

💚💚

For the first time

A time that begins in my name

The moment my choices begin to accumulate

Now, the National Pension

Be with you at that starting line

✔ The government supports the first month's premium

On the same starting line,

So that we can start more fairly

#NationalPension #YouthPolicy

#PreparingForTheFuture #SocialSafetyNet #MinistryOfHealthAndWelfare
